boundary: These are request-construction contracts. They do not replace behavior law or execute verbs.

point.purpose: Request an exact source/section relationship or a correction to that relationship.
point.hold: Do not copy the governing body, invent a missing source, or treat routing as permission to change a seat.
point.basis: Proposal informed by 05.09 and law 0033.point (signed test, not authority to execute).

note.purpose: Request preservation of a specific explanation, uncertainty, or Director decision.
note.hold: Preserve history; a note does not approve a draft or release another item.
note.basis: Proposal informed by face 06 and 05.08/05.09 usage; placement/append mechanic still needs law.

redraft.purpose: Request a coherent replacement draft from named current material and decisions.
redraft.hold: No seat replacement, signature, approval, or lock. Read named predecessors and governing sources first.
redraft.basis: Law 0021.write Order/Name and 05.09. Unsigned amendment versus a new version is stated in output_plan.

fix.purpose: Request a bounded correction to a demonstrated defect.
fix.hold: Not a general redesign; name patch versus draft and its authority before acting.
fix.basis: Law 0021.write Fix. Current local dev exceptions must be reopened, not inferred from this contract.

patch.purpose: Request a small dated change where an explicit current rule allows that edit.
patch.hold: No broad rewrite. A stated patch_basis is a claim to review, not verified authorization.
patch.basis: Law 0021.write Patch and current dev exceptions; prototype does not choose between conflicting policies.

check.purpose: Request inspection against named criteria and a report of the differences.
check.hold: Read-only inspection. No automatic correction or approval.
check.basis: Proposal inspection contract; checker README is mechanics, not a grant of permission.

strike.purpose: Request marking an exact obsolete sentence while preserving the record.
strike.hold: No deletion of history; do not expand a strike into a rewrite.

sign.purpose: Request a signature decision for explicitly identified draft files.
sign.hold: No signing by this tool. Signature does not seat or approve. Assigned role requires current governing authority.
sign.basis: Law 0021.write Name and current axioms Hats/Marks. Repository AGENTS prohibits this worker signing.

approve.purpose: Request the Director approval decision for named signed drafts and their transition plan.
approve.hold: No approval or renames by this tool. No inferred approval from a reply or signature.

clean.purpose: Request a bounded cleanup review with recoverable evidence and named exclusions.
clean.hold: No deletion or cleanup by this tool; no snapshot means no clean; open higher drafts require a hold.
